svg.title: What a native build actually does
svg.desc: Two grids of small squares side by side. The left grid, labelled everything available, is completely filled and represents your jar plus the whole JDK. An arrow labelled trace points to the right grid, labelled what ends up shipped, where only about a fifth of the squares remain filled. A red band underneath warns that anything reached by name at runtime looks unreachable and gets deleted too.

text.font-family: Virgil, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', Chalkboard, cursive
